title: Introduction to Redux Hooks
overview: React Redux provides hooks that allow functional components to interact with the Redux store easily.

example.title: Redux Hooks
example.content:
useSelector → Read state
useDispatch → Send actions

title: useSelector Hook
overview: useSelector is used to extract specific data from the Redux store and subscribe a component to state changes.

title: Selecting Specific State
overview: Components should select only the required data from the store to avoid unnecessary re-renders.

title: useDispatch Hook
overview: useDispatch returns a dispatch function that allows components to send actions to reducers.

title: Using useSelector and useDispatch Together
overview: Most Redux components use both hooks together to read state and update state based on user actions.

example.title: Combined Usage

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how useSelector reads Redux state and useDispatch sends actions to update the application state.

example.title: Quick Revision
example.content:
✔ useSelector reads data.
✔ useDispatch sends actions.
✔ Both hooks connect components with Redux store.
